lines.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 인어 나라가 있었어요. 바다 왕님과 할머니, 여섯 공주가 살았지요.
lines.en: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.
segs: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.

lines.text: 막내 인어공주는 조용하고 생각이 많았어요. 정원에는 배에서 떨어진 물건을 모았어요.
lines.en: The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.
segs: The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.

lines.text: 무거운 것은 가라앉고, 가벼운 것은 떠요. 어느 것이 바다 밑까지 내려올까요?
lines.en: Heavy things sink, and light things float. Which one will come all the way down to the sea floor?
segs: Heavy things sink, and light things float. Which one will come all the way down to the sea floor?

lines.en: The piece of wood is light, so it floats.
segs: The piece of wood is light, so it floats.

lines.en: The heavy stone sank!
This time, which one will sink?
segs: This time, which one will sink?

lines.en: The cork bottle is light, so it floats.
segs: The cork bottle is light, so it floats.

lines.en: The heavy anchor sank too!

lines.text: 언니들은 열다섯 살이 되면 바다 위로 올라갔어요. 드디어 막내 차례예요!
lines.en: When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!
segs: When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!

lines.en: Be careful, and come back safely.
segs: Be careful, and come back safely.

lines.en: Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!
segs: Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!

lines.text: 커다란 배가 있었어요. 오늘은 왕자님 생일이래요.
lines.en: There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.
segs: There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.

lines.en: Tap the sky!
Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.
segs: Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.

lines.en: So that is the prince.

lines.text: 밤이 깊자 바람이 세졌어요. 배가 기우뚱!
lines.en: Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!
segs: Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!

lines.en: The prince fell into the sea.
segs: The prince fell into the sea.

lines.en: I will help you!

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님의 머리를 물 위로 받쳐 주었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.
segs: The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님을 모래밭에 눕히고, 바위 뒤에 숨었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.
segs: The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.

lines.en: Oh my, are you all right?
segs: Oh my, are you all right?

lines.text: 왕자님은 아가씨에게 웃어 주었어요. 인어공주는 보지 못했지요.
lines.en: The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.
segs: The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.

lines.en: The prince is awake. I am so glad.
segs: The prince is awake. I am so glad.

lines.en: Grandmother, how do people live?

lines.text: 사람은 땅 위에서 살고, 우리는 바다에서 살지. 사람에겐 별처럼 영원히 남는 마음이 있단다.
lines.en: People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.
segs: People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.

lines.text: 나도 왕자님 곁에서 그런 마음을 갖고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.
segs: I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.

lines.text: 인어공주는 소용돌이 너머 바다 마녀를 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.
segs: The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.

lines.text: 다리를 갖고 싶다고? 좋아. 대신 네 고운 목소리를 다오.
lines.en: You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.
segs: You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.

lines.text: 다리는 조금 흔들흔들할 거야. 그리고 왕자가 다른 사람과 결혼하면, 너는 바다 거품이 된단다.
lines.en: Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.
segs: Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.

lines.en: I will go anyway.
Tap the cauldron!

lines.text: 마녀가 목소리를 진주처럼 가져갔어요. 이제 인어공주는 말을 할 수 없어요.
lines.en: The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.
segs: The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.

lines.text: 새벽, 궁전 계단에서 인어공주는 약을 마셨어요.
lines.en: At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.
segs: At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.

lines.text: 꼬리가 사라지고 다리가 생겼어요! 걸음은 흔들흔들.
lines.en: Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.
segs: Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.

lines.en: Who are you? Where did you come from?
segs: Who are you? Where did you come from?

lines.text: 인어공주는 말을 못 해요. 그저 웃었지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.
segs: The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.

lines.en: Come and stay at our palace.
segs: Come and stay at our palace.

lines.text: 정원에 바다 친구가 섞였네. 바다에 사는 친구를 찾아봐요.
lines.en: Some sea friends got mixed into the garden. Let's find the friends that live in the sea.
segs: Some sea friends got mixed into the garden. Let's find the friends that live in the sea.

lines.en: Which friend lives in the sea?
segs: Which friend lives in the sea?

lines.en: The fish lives in the sea!
segs: The fish lives in the sea!

lines.en: The shell lives in the sea!
segs: The shell lives in the sea!

lines.en: The starfish lives in the sea!
segs: The starfish lives in the sea!

lines.en: The butterfly flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
segs: The butterfly flies in the sky. It is a land friend.

lines.en: The rabbit hops on the land. It is a land friend.
segs: The rabbit hops on the land. It is a land friend.

lines.en: The flower blooms on the land. It is a land friend.
segs: The flower blooms on the land. It is a land friend.

lines.en: The bird flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
segs: The bird flies in the sky. It is a land friend.

lines.en: The tree grows on the land. It is a land friend.
segs: The tree grows on the land. It is a land friend.

lines.en: The puppy runs on the land. It is a land friend.
segs: The puppy runs on the land. It is a land friend.

lines.text: 바다에서 온 아이 같아요. 내 귀여운 동생처럼 지내요.
lines.en: You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.
segs: You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.

lines.en: Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.
segs: Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.

lines.text: 당신이 모래밭에서 저를 구해 준 분이군요!
lines.en: You are the one who saved me on the beach!
segs: You are the one who saved me on the beach!

lines.text: 왕자님은 이웃 나라 공주님과 결혼했어요. 인어공주는 말없이 웃었어요. 마음은 아팠지요.
lines.en: The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.
segs: The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.

lines.text: 새벽, 배 옆에 언니들이 올라왔어요. 긴 머리가 짧아졌어요.
lines.en: At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.
segs: At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.

lines.text: 인어공주는 잠든 왕자님과 공주님을 보았어요. 그리고 고개를 저었지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.
segs: The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.

lines.text: 인어공주는 단검을 칼집째 바다에 던졌어요. 물결이 붉은 금빛으로 반짝였어요. 해가 떠올랐어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.
segs: The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.

lines.text: 인어공주는 반짝이는 거품이 되어 하늘로 둥실 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.
segs: The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.

lines.text: 인어공주는 부드러운 바닷바람이 되었어요. 길 잃은 배의 돛을 밀어 주고, 더운 날엔 시원한 바람을 보내지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.
segs: The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.

lines.en: Tap the bubble light to say hello!
segs: Tap the bubble light to say hello!

lines.text: 사랑하는 마음은 사라지지 않아요. 안녕, 또 만나요!
lines.en: A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!
segs: A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!

lines.text: 사랑하는 마음으로 양보하면, 그 마음은 좋은 일이 되어 남아요.
lines.en: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.
segs: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.

ch2: If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
